page.layout: One column of running text, one printed page (left margin and right margin empty). Arabic example words are set inline within the first paragraph. No running head, no catchword, no notes. Page number at head, gathering signature at foot.

main_text.p: & nunquā satis æstimanda appendice, possunt & conjugationes verborum perfectorum memoriæ mandari: ac primo quidem tabella illa tredecim Conjugationum, quam exhibet lib. 2. cap. 1. diligenter discenda est, eaque cognitā, verba quædam alia trilitera, ut [illegible, ~3 letters] [illegible, ~3 letters] [illegible, ~3 letters] [illegible, ~3 letters] & alia quælibet per eam diduci debent, ut oblatæ cujusque radicis conjugationem quamlibet nullo negotio formare discas. Hinc progrediendū ad Paradigma primæ conjugationis Activæ, quod benè memoriæ est imprimendum, cum ab eo reliqui omnia dependeant: mox præcepta ei adjuncta legenda quoque & discenda sunt:

Deinde differentiæ conjugationum derivativarum à primâ, sequentibus duobus capitibus traditæ, memoriæ quoque infigi debent, & radices plures per primas tantum temporum voces in prima conjugatione, & reliquis diducendæ sunt; nec ante pergendum ad verba imperfecta quàm perfectorum conjugationes omnes tum primitivæ tum derivativæ benè perfectæ & cognitæ sint. Hinc ad imperfecta fiat progressus, et singulis speciebus singuli dentur dies, confusionis evitandæ gratiâ, beneque considerentur, & memoriæ mandentur generales imperfectionis rationes, quæ sub initium.

page.notes: The three Arabic words in the first paragraph (after "ut", and the line of "& alia quælibet") could not be read letter by letter and are marked illegible. Printed Arabic characters are not reproduced. Hyphenated line-end words were joined: cogni-tâ, ra-dicis, adjun-cta, per-fectæ, be-neque, ini-tium. The page has a printed "(79)" at the head and the gathering signature "G 4" at the foot. The word "tium" at the end of the last line is the second half of "initium", not a catchword.
